  • When arriving on-scene you grab a basic EMS kit and check ABC: Airway, Breathing, and Circulation.
  • If not breathing the kit has a bag valve ventilator which is used to ventilate the lungs. Very quickly oxygen is connected to it.
  • If there is no pulse chest compressions are started and continued while loading the victim into the ambulance.
  • If no pulse is detected once in the ambulance, the defibrillator is used.
  • You must keep working the victim until you reach the hospital and the doctor takes over.
